about: What a security prompt's override text counts as. The server decides whether a pairing can run from it (SecurityPromptText.Classify, used by SecurityRoster.ReadPrompt); the extension's Security lane tab draws each card from it (securityPromptFiles.ts). Both halves answer these vectors, so the two copies cannot drift. text null = no file; repeat/count builds a long text.

vectors.name: an empty file, as Edit creates it
the operator placeholder alone
vectors.text: <!-- OPERATOR: write the review prompt here -->

vectors.name: ordinary text
vectors.text: Review the change for exploitable failures.

vectors.name: two-byte characters exactly at the limit
a next-line character only (U+0085, whitespace to .NET)
a zero-width space only (whitespace to neither side)
a byte-order mark only, as text (not whitespace to .NET; a FILE starting with one is read without it)
the placeholder wrapped in next-line characters
